second_reviewer_order.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-10-11: GitHub Copilot is the second reviewer and the local model is the fallback used only when Copilot does not answer. With --second-reviewer auto the first name is tried first and the second name is tried at the moment the first fails or is unavailable

strip_markup_tags.provenance: specified 2026-10-12 after a measured defect: the cleaning step used to delete everything between any '<' and the next '>', which erased the inequalities of a mathematical draft (6793 characters reduced to 2101 without a warning). Only these markup tag names, written as a tag with no attribute or with name=value attributes, and HTML comments are now removed. The list is the set of tags pdf2md and mineru emit in converted documents

strip_loss_warn_ratio.provenance: chosen by the session 2026-10-12, to be confirmed by the operator: when the cleaning step removes more than this share of the draft characters, the envelope's context.warnings says so with both sizes, since a silent loss of context makes the reviewers answer a different question
